theme_and_archetype.reasoning: Explicitly requested neon purple and electric blue on dark theme. Requires an energetic, high-contrast, futuristic approach for a Live Stage.

headings.rules: Never center by default. Use heavy weight for high tension. Left align for structural integrity.

colors.rules: Avoid pure black, use #05050A. Never use pure #808080 gray, tint with blue. Ensure all text over neon backgrounds is pure white with text-shadow for APCA contrast. Primary CTA gets Purple, secondary action gets Cyan outline.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing, Optical Alignment, Negative Space.
layout_and_spacing.padding: Containers with borders must use p-6 or p-8.
layout_and_spacing.rules: Mobile-first grids. Asymmetry is preferred. If an element has a round icon on the left, use optical alignment (extra padding on the left).

crystal_glass.usage: Now Playing Bar, Sticky Headers, Floating Video Controls

retro_terminal.usage: Live Chat Container, Audio Level Meters

main_dashboard_stream.layout: Mode A (Tetris Grid) combined with media scrolling.
main_dashboard_stream.hero_section: Massive col-span-full card for 'Cover Battle Arena' or 'Become a Star'. Left aligned massive text. Background image with bg-gradient-to-r from-[#05050A] via-[#05050A]/80 to-transparent. Opacity max 40%.
main_dashboard_stream.music_shelves: Horizontal scrollable rows (gap-6) for Top Albums, Top Songs. Hide scrollbars.
main_dashboard_stream.now_playing: Fixed bottom bar (above mobile nav). Use 'crystal_glass' surface. Prominent album art, neon glowing progress bar (bg-[#00E5FF]).

live_stage_recording.main_stage_view: col-span-12 lg:col-span-9. Content fits in max-h-[80vh] container to avoid overflow. Video element has rounded-xl border border-white/5 and subtle neon ambient glow.
live_stage_recording.stage_modes: 4 Layouts (Camera, Split, Lyrics, Guitar). Switch seamlessly. If split, render dual video feeds with gap-4.
live_stage_recording.floating_controls: Centered at the bottom of the video feed. Use 'crystal_glass' rounded-full pill shape. Record button is bright Neon Purple.

live_chat.layout: col-span-12 lg:col-span-3. Can live in a side panel next to the Live Stage.
live_chat.toggle: Shadcn Tabs customized. Segmented control switching between 'Live' (real-time stream) and 'Comments' (threaded static).
live_chat.live_mode: Auto-scroll container, aria-live='polite'. Messages fade-in from bottom. Dense padding (py-1). No avatars, username colored in neon cyan.
live_chat.comments_mode: Standard scrolling, gap-4 between comments. Avatars present. bg-white/5 rounded-lg p-3.
live_chat.input: Sticky bottom input field inside chat. border-white/20 focus-within:border-[#8A2BE2] bg-transparent.

components.buttons: Always include focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#00E5FF] focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-[#05050A].
components.tabs: Override Shadcn h-9 fixed height. Use h-auto. Active state uses border-b-2 border-[#00E5FF] text-[#00E5FF].
components.cards: Avoid Shadcn Card generic borders. Use border-white/5 hover:border-white/15 transition-colors duration-300.
components.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid (e.g., data-testid='live-chat-toggle', data-testid='record-start-button').

motion_and_interactions.hover: Explicit hover text color, slightly lighter hue for active elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Start by updating Tailwind configuration to include the neon primary/secondary colors and custom fonts (Outfit and Manrope).
2. Implement the 'Main Dashboard' (Stream Page) first as the default landing route. Ensure heavy bento grid layout and horizontal scrolling lists.
3. Build the 'Live Stage' wrapper, ensuring it consumes full viewport height minus navigation to feel like a dedicated studio app. Apply glassmorphism on the floating record controls.
4. Build the 'Live Chat' component as a modular sidebar piece. Implement the Tabs for toggling between 'Live' and 'Comments' logic. Add `aria-live` regions.
5. Every button, input, and interactive UI piece MUST include a `data-testid` (e.g., `data-testid='live-chat-toggle'`).
6. Do not wrap raw HTML inside unnecessary containers if it breaks the CSS Grid layout (Direct Children Rule).
7. Never use Inter or generic sans for headings. Apply `font-outfit` and `font-black`.
8. Maintain extreme contrast. Neon elements must glow over `#05050A` background using shadow utilities.
